question: Find the name and nationality of the driver who recorded the fastest lap (in terms of milliseconds) during any race held at the Monaco Grand Prix circuit before the year 2000. Also return the corresponding lap time in 'M:SS.mmm' format and the year of that race.

SELECT
    d.XCL_038 AS driver_name,
    d.XCL_041 AS nationality,
    r.XCL_088 AS lap_time,
    rc.XCL_066 AS race_year
FROM results AS r
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON d.XCL_034 = r.XCL_075
INNER JOIN races AS rc ON rc.XCL_065 = r.XCL_074
WHERE rc.XCL_069 = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
  AND rc.XCL_066 < 2000
  AND r.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (CAST(SUBSTR(r.XCL_088, 1, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
         + CAST(SUBSTR(r.XCL_088, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') + 1) AS REAL)) ASC
LIMIT 1
